title: Audit recent RDP logons
description: List successful and failed Remote Desktop (RDP) logon events

windowsCommandTemplate.name: Get-WinEvent
windowsCommandTemplate.commandPattern: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4624,4625; StartTime=(Get-Date).AddDays(-{days})} | Where-Object {$_.Message -like '*LogonType*10*' -or $_.Message -like '*LogonType*3*'} | Select-Object TimeCreated,Id,@{Name='EventType';Expression={if($_.Id -eq 4624){'Success'}else{'Failed'}}},Message | Format-Table -AutoSize

parameters.name: days
parameters.label: Number of days
parameters.description: Number of days to look back

examples.description: Show every property of the first returned object. Select-Object * widens the output to every column, -First 1 keeps the first result. Use it to discover the available properties before filtering.

examples.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4624,4625; StartTime=(Get-Date).AddDays(-30)} | Export-Csv C:\Temp\Export.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8
examples.description: Export the results to a CSV file Excel can open. -NoTypeInformation drops the metadata line, -Encoding UTF8 keeps accented characters intact. Useful for archiving, reports and external analysis.
Count the returned objects. Measure-Object returns Count, Sum, Average, Min and Max depending on the properties. Useful for quick statistics and checking results.

notes: EventID 4624 = successful logon, 4625 = failure. LogonType 10 = RemoteInteractive (RDP), 3 = Network. Watch for repeated failures (attack).

fr.title: Auditer les connexions RDP récentes
fr.description: Liste les événements de connexion Bureau à distance (RDP) réussies et échouées
fr.notes: EventID 4624 = connexion réussie, 4625 = échec. LogonType 10 = RemoteInteractive (RDP), 3 = Network. Surveillez les échecs répétés (attaque).

days.label: Nombre de jours
days.description: Nombre de jours à analyser en arrière
